self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: R5 Echo of a Vow: triggering any Elemental Reaction grants +120 Elemental Mastery for 12s. Works off-field.

R5 Echo of a Vow: triggering a Stellar Glimmer reaction increases Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG by 32% for 12s. Applied as stellarglimmer_dmg_, the umbrella key that reaches both Stellar-Conduct and Stellar Swirl hits, so this buff is correctly scoped for either. Stellar Swirl DMG itself is still unimplemented (no reaction constants), so a Swirl rotation has no hits for it to land on yet. Stacks with afterElementalReaction.

source.note: 7.0 weapon, added 2026-08-08 from nanoka 6.7.54 beta data (neither Amber nor GO carry it yet). Base stats derived as init x levels['90'] + last ascension add, the same derivation validated to the cent against 15 existing seed files. Buffs baked at R5 (house convention: 4* at R5, 5* at R1).
